registerNotMeasured: Not measured. This file is a cognate record, not a register pass: there is no scripts/l10n/detectors/es.js and nothing here measured the formal/informal register of the es bundle, so selfcheck must not report a register verdict for es.
scopeNote: COGNATE RECORD for es. Every value in l10n/es.json that was byte-identical to the English source has been reviewed one by one: each is either recorded below with a written reason, or was replaced by a real translation in the same pass. The list is therefore closed - a NEW identical value in es means a new judgement, not an existing licence.

cognates.3: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.30: Numeric literal; identical in every locale.
cognates.Avatar: International term, spelled and used identically in Spanish.
cognates.Color: Same spelling and meaning in Spanish (el color).
cognates.ConfigSet: Apache SOLR's own object name; used untranslated in Spanish SOLR documentation.
cognates.ConfigSet:: Apache SOLR's object name plus a colon; nothing translatable.
cognates.DSAR: Acronym (Data Subject Access Request); used untranslated in Spanish privacy practice.
cognates.Deck: Nextcloud app name; kept untranslated in every finished locale.
cognates.Endpoints: Spanish API documentation keeps 'endpoint'; the plural is also 'endpoints'.
cognates.Error: Same spelling and meaning in Spanish (el error).
cognates.Excel (.xlsx): Product name plus a file extension; nothing translatable.
cognates.Facetable: 'Facetable' is also the Spanish adjective formed from 'faceta'.
cognates.Host: 'Host' is the Spanish technical term too.
cognates.Host *: 'Host' is the Spanish technical term; the asterisk is a required-field marker.
cognates.ID:: Acronym plus a colon; Spanish puts no space before a colon.
cognates.Id: The same acronym in the casing the source uses.
cognates.Local: Same spelling and meaning in Spanish (local).
cognates.N/A: Not-applicable abbreviation, kept as-is in every locale of this app.
cognates.No: Same spelling and meaning in Spanish (no).
cognates.OpenCorporates: Name of an external data source; a proper noun.
cognates.OpenDocument (.ods): Format name plus a file extension; nothing translatable.
cognates.OpenRegister: The application's own name; a proper noun.
cognates.RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation acronym; used untranslated in Spanish technical writing.
cognates.RBAC: Access-control acronym; used untranslated in Spanish technical writing.
cognates.Reversible: Same spelling and meaning in Spanish (reversible).
cognates.Simple: Same spelling and meaning in Spanish (simple).
cognates.Slug: URL-slug term, kept untranslated in Spanish CMS and API tooling.
cognates.Total: Same spelling and meaning in Spanish (el total).
cognates.Total:: Same word plus a colon; Spanish puts no space before a colon.
cognates.UUID:: Acronym plus a colon; Spanish puts no space before a colon.
cognates.Webhook: Established loan; the standard term in Spanish technical UI language.
cognates.Webhooks: Established loan; the Spanish plural is also 'Webhooks'.
